items.exampleEn: You should apologize to your sister.
Don't click on anything in that email.

items.exampleEn: This website has great cooking ideas.
items.exampleZh: 這個網站有很棒的料理點子。

items.exampleEn: The girls chatted and laughed all afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 女孩們聊天說笑了一整個下午。

items.exampleEn: In the movie, a man clones himself.
items.exampleZh: 電影裡，有個男人複製了自己。

items.exampleEn: I got a text message from my bank.
items.exampleZh: 我收到銀行傳來的簡訊。

items.exampleEn: Save this web page so you can read it later.
items.exampleZh: 把這個網頁存起來，你等一下可以再看。

items.sentenceEn: I can't print anything because the printer is broken.
items.sentenceZh: 印表機壞了，所以我什麼都不能印。

items.audioEn: Click the red button to start the game.
items.audioZh: 點紅色的按鈕就能開始遊戲。
items.questionZh: 要點哪個按鈕才能開始遊戲？

items.sentenceEn: I chat with my cousin online every night.
items.sentenceZh: 我每天晚上都和表姊在網路上聊天。

items.sentenceEn: Please read the text message I sent you.

items.stemEn: He ____ to his teacher for being late.
items.stemZh: 他因為遲到向老師道歉。

items.stemEn: You can find all our prices on our ____.
items.stemZh: 你可以在我們的網站上找到所有價格。

items.passageEn: My grandmother is learning to use the internet. First, I showed her how to find a website and click on pictures. Now she chats with her friends online and sends text messages. She even has a favorite web page about cats. Yesterday, she printed some photos on our printer and put them in an envelope for my aunt. When she made a mistake, she said, "I apologize, computer!"
items.passageZh: 我奶奶正在學用網路。我先教她怎麼找網站、怎麼點圖片。現在她會在網路上和朋友聊天，也會傳簡訊。她甚至有一個最喜歡的貓咪網頁。昨天，她用我們的印表機印了幾張照片，放進信封要寄給我阿姨。弄錯的時候，她還說：「電腦，對不起！」

questions.questionZh: 奶奶現在會用網路做什麼？
options: 每天晚上在網路上看電影
上網買新衣服和新鞋子

questions.questionZh: 奶奶把印出來的照片怎麼處理？
options: 全部送給隔壁的老鄰居
全部貼在客廳的大牆上

rubricZh: 「複製」用 clone，時態配合句意（例如 cloned、have cloned）
主詞可寫例如 Scientists、The scientists

referenceEn: He apologized to everyone for being late.
He apologized to everybody for coming late.
rubricZh: 用 apologize to＋人＋for＋事 表示「為…向…道歉」（例如 apologized to everyone for being late）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 apologized、has apologized 等）
